segments.sn5.6:1.2: Atha kho cālā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā … pe … aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn5.6:1.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena cālā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā cālaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn5.6:2.1: “Kiṃ nu jātiṃ na rocesi, jāto kāmāni bhuñjati;
segments.sn5.6:2.3: Ko nu taṃ idamādapayi, jātiṃ mā roca [mā rocesi (sī. pī.)] bhikkhunī”ti.
segments.sn5.6:3.1: “Jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti, jāto dukkhāni phussati [passati (sī. pī.)];
segments.sn5.6:3.3: Bandhaṃ vadhaṃ pariklesaṃ, tasmā jātiṃ na rocaye.
segments.sn5.6:5.1: “Ye ca rūpūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino;
segments.sn5.6:6.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ cālā bhikkhunī”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe ko nu taṃ idamādapayīti ko nu mandabuddhi bālo taṃ evaṃ gāhāpesi?
“na maṃ andhabālo ādapesi, loke pana aggapuggalo satthā dhammaṃ desesī”ti dassetuṃ, buddhotiādimāha.
